title: Blinded Thomas 7 reconstruction evaluation package (JAK-43 readiness)

seal.leakage_rule: Do not train or select reconstruction rules using P.Oxy. 654 / Thomas-7 Greek, direct Thomas-specific reconstructions, or manual mappings derived from that fragment. A general NT-learned correspondence that happens to predict the same Greek word is permissible.
seal.notes: Greek fragment text is intentionally omitted from this package. Resolve surviving letters only from the sealed fragment corpus at scoring time (JAK-40). Editorial restorations must not enter the scoring denominator.

loanword_clues.restrictions: Lexical clue only — not automatic proof of case/tense/number/syntax.

allowed_training_stack: NT-learned mappings excluding evaluation-witness Greek Thomas fragments
forbidden_training_inputs: thomas.7 Greek fragment tokens or restorations
manual Coptic→Greek mappings derived from P.Oxy. 654

rules: Score surviving Greek letters independently of editorial restorations.
Fluent Greek is not automatically a better reconstruction.
Legitimate ancient textual variation is not automatic algorithmic error.
Compare against a word-for-word baseline on identical inputs (JAK-41).
No invented numeric pass/fail threshold before measuring the baseline.

review_checklist: Confirm Coptic Dilley unit_id thomas.7 matches bundled Dilley corpus bytes.
Confirm Greek witness remains sealed in this package (no P.Oxy. 654 text inline).
Confirm evaluation_witness_exclusions on split v3 still list poxy-654-dclp covering thomas.7.
Confirm loanword clue is labeled clue-only, not morphology proof.
Independent reviewer signs review_status → human-checked before JAK-40 scoring run.
notes: Prepared under JAK-43 so JAK-40/41 can score without improvised labels. NT holdout gold expansion uses the same review_status vocabulary (see docs/eval-data-readiness.md).
